critic.quote: Lorelei and the Laser Eyes is nothing short of a triumph for the puzzle games genre. Its excellent and challenging puzzle design is perfectly complemented by a beautifully minimalistic aesthetic, creating a total package that fans of the genre simply should not miss for any reason.

Lorelei and the Laser Eyes can sometimes feel like the Dark Souls of puzzle games, but no one will regret challenging themselves to solve its many mysteries. Players who enjoy analyzing complex stories will have a blast taking apart the many layers to Lorelei and the Laser Eye's bizarre tale, while those looking for an addicting puzzle game will find it to be an incredibly satisfying adventure. Lo
Lorelei and the Laser Eyes is magnificently crafted, oozing with detail, love, and care. What it does amazingly is give you all the tools you need to figure out this mystery within the hotel.

This is one of those games that I’ll think about even after I finish it. As of the time of writing, I still have quite a few mysteries to uncover, as there are some puzzles that just well and truly stumped me. The world it presents is a cryptic one, reminding me of old conspiracy theories from before my time, but it keeps you coming back for more, hankering to pull back the curtains and unlock the

Lorelei and the Laser Eyes is a new success for the creators of Sayonara Wild Hearts. This narrative mystery adventure catches you at the first opportunity and forces you to leave your comfort zone to face all kinds of puzzles full of imagination.
A gloriously surreal third person puzzle game, set in a hotel where everything from its rooms to its artwork is part of a multi-layered mystery of time travel, mazes, and the occult.

s.desc:
体验历久弥新的传奇冒险
施展雷曼的标志性冲拳与直升机发型滑翔，穿越缤纷世界，从拥有难忘蚊子坐骑的梦幻森林，到充满音乐狂欢的音乐天，任你驰骋。在这款经典平台冒险游戏中，你将营救电子精灵，从暗影先生手中拯救世界。其魅力至今仍如 90 年代时那般令人沉醉。
最终确定版
任你畅玩五大经典版本（MS-DOS、PlayStation®、Atari Jaguar、GBC 及 GBA）的传奇冒险，现配备全新重制的沉浸式原声，更额外收录来自《雷曼新关卡》《雷曼 60 关》及《雷曼粉丝自制》的 120 余个新增关卡。你将首次体验失传已久的 SNES 原型版本，亲睹雷曼创新玩法最初是如何成型的，机会难得。
专属纪录片

让大家乐在其中的经典之作
重温风靡一时的经典玩法，或通过全新设计的功能迎接挑战，其中包括即时回溯、多存档位及无限生命、瞬间解锁关卡等辅助选项，让你乐趣不断。

critic.quote: The Rayman 30th Anniversary Edition is a fun trip down memory lane, letting you experience the different platforms the first game launched on from the comfort of your Nintendo Switch. You can even pick up a physical copy that includes nice goodies, which are sure to please collectors. However, there's a missed opportunity in not including Rayman 2 and 3.

Rayman 30th Anniversary Edition is the perfect way to play a classic game in all its forms. While the PlayStation version has seen the most love and is the ideal way to play, it's great to have so many different releases represented. There's a good amount of bells and whistles to round out the collection too, and to take a break with when you get frustrated by the overwhelming difficulty.

Rayman: 30th Anniversary Edition does Ubisoft’s old mascot proud. It is one of the most complete packages for those who want to revisit Rayman’s history. It includes five versions of the original title, extra levels, and a prototype. There is plenty of gameplay and even more time to spend with the character, especially if you watch the history documentary. It is a little strange, however, that Ubi
For a surprise, low-cost look into Rayman history, Rayman 30th Anniversary Edition is a neat little treat. But it

Rayman 30th Anniversary Edition shows that the slick gameplay and exquisite art style of Rayman are still as fun and enjoyable today as they were three decades ago. Nevertheless, this edition acts more as a modern port than as a definitive anniversary collection at some points, namely due to the lack of accessibility options for new players, and features an arranged version of the game's soundtra

This compilation is like being patted by a worn-down piece of sandpaper for fans: it might feel gentle in a few spots, but it’s still going to scrape. Without the franchise’s original signature music and with quality-of-life tweaks like rewinding after a mistake, it comes with clear pros and cons. The standout addition is that new rewind feature, which is going to make it possible to actually fini

critic.quote: Undemanding and decidedly enjoyable, Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising is a light-hearted and often cartoon-like Action JRPG which is really fun to spend your time with. Of course, you don't have to have anything against going back and forth a thousand times in the same places, to do the same things again and again, because in this case appreciating it would be quite difficult. The visual quality is reall

Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising has a slow and snore-worthy opening hour, but hiding behind that repetitive introduction is an incredible blend of high-octane 2.5D combat and rewarding resource gathering gameplay. The icing on the cake, though, is the Marvel Cinematic Universe-worthy parade of character cameos and appearances that promise some of the many faces you'll be battling alongside (or maybe eve

Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising has made a substantial effort to use a rich narrative with charming characters to create a genuinely wholesome world. However, the side quests serve as a barrier, as they entail the monotonous affair of gathering materials. Hopefully, Hundred Heroes will not fall prey to the same shortcomings as this introduction chapter.

Taken as a spin-off ahead of the long-awaited Eiyuden Chronicle, Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising offers great world-building and characters. That said, the repetitive gameplay mechanics do get in the way of making this a great action RPG that can stand by itself.

I truly wish Rising’s gameplay systems were more engaging, as the story and characters had me genuinely engaged. There’s nothing about the game that’s particularly bad. But outside of the story, there’s nothing that’s particularly exceptional either. The flood of backtracking and busy work feels ripped right out of a classic JRPG, but not in a good way. If anything, this game makes me cautiously e
Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising has flashy combat and gorgeous visuals, but the repetitive gameplay loop really holds it back.

s.desc:
你和你的朋友被困在城堡岩石里，无路可走——是被人背叛了，还是你们根本就没那么聪明？在这次神秘的南极冒险中，一起逃离、探索并解决谜题。请注意，一切都不是看上去那么简单——秘密和谜题都隐藏在阴影里。你们有能力逃离吗？
从城堡岩石深处的地牢开始，你和你的囚犯同伴必须找到出路，以重新回到冰冷的南极天空之下——但是要逃离这场噩梦并不像逃离城堡本身那么简单。如果你从牢房中逃脱了出来，你需要选择接下来去哪里探索。在要塞外面，你会发现城堡居民岩底人的故事，以及他们为了逃离这个冰冷地方而反抗国王的计划。“希望”会带你去到一个阴森恐怖的墓地，从而潜入铸造厂的黑暗水域。
某些人，或某些东西把你们带到了这里，因为你们是制定了几个世纪的计划的核心部分。面对如此可怕的欲望，只有你和同伴之间坚不可摧的纽带才能带给你们生存的希望……
FEATURES
• 双人合作：你们遇到的谜题都需要两个人一起解决——你们都需要扮演自己的角色！通过对讲机交流，并充当彼此的眼睛和耳朵。

s.desc:
本款游戏支援简体中文和繁体中文。
《Bramble:The Mountain King》将带你穿梭于各种令人震惊的环境之中，开启一段即恐怖又引人入胜的旅程。你将扮演一名叫做奥莱的男孩，他将启程营救自己那被一头可怕巨魔所绑架的妹妹。
荆棘之地的一切并非你看上去的那么简单——这片奇怪大地中存在各种大大小小的生物，你必须小心地接近它们并适时躲避危险。许多饥饿且凶残的猛兽都潜伏在森林和洞穴之中。它们正紧盯着你的每一步动作……
你将前往寻找勇气火花，这件具有魔法之力的碎片将赋予你在一路上渡过陷阱和考验的能力。同时，你还将以各种独特的方式击败那些可怕的生物。但也要小心，一味地杀戮将使你最终走上黑暗之路。
主要特点
• 扮演奥莱展开冒险之旅，这名勇敢的小男孩将启程营救自己的妹妹。
• 探索一个美丽但危险的世界。
• 直面那些来自北欧神话的扭曲神话生物，并展开一场场史诗规模的 Boss 战。
• 体验在高端画面加持之下的紧张，且扣人心弦的各种场景。

critic.quote: At its core, Bramble: The Mountain King is a storybook brought to life in the best way possible. Olle’s search for his sister is a wonderful journey inspired by Nordic folklore that is aided by magnificent landscapes, unsettling mythological creatures and an intriguing narrative that culminates in a touching tale of bravery in the face of darkness.

Bramble: The Mountain King is a fascinating adventure. Each character you meet on your Nordic expedition is wonderfully designed and will instantly capture your imagination. Even though the movement is a little rigid and the game is extremely linear, it manages to deliver a unique experience that will fester in your psyche.

Bramble: The Mountain King might not be the best game for players who like challenging puzzles and advanced platform sections, but it is a very interesting adventure game with dark themes and enough diversity in gameplay to keep the game interesting.

A collection of Nordic telltales, easy to understand for everybody. While gruesome visual is increasing overall immersion, it is quite regretful that the game is offering somewhat short story, monotonous boss battle and puzzles.

Bramble: The Mountain King combines elements of an under-explored culture in games to create a great fantasy and horror experience. It's a game that's definitely worth checking out if you're a fan of the genre.
The Mountain King weaves a powerful and at times disturbing tale, but falls a bit short on its gameplay.

s.desc:
《索拉斯塔：大法师之冠》带您重温桌面游戏的精彩，体验桌游的战术和深度叙事，让您身临其境，仿佛自己正拿着骰子和微缩模型。是时候进入索拉斯塔世界了！
掷骰检定先攻，进行借机攻击，组织好角色位置和战场的垂直平面。做好准备，使出终极一击，在战斗的关键时刻或许能掷出自然 20 点，力挽狂澜。在《索拉斯塔》中，您的麾下有四位英雄，每一位都有自己独特的技能，彼此相辅相成。每位英雄在冒险旅程中都会表达出自己的态度和看法，让每一次行动和每一个对话选择都成为剧情中动态的一部分。玩家在创建英雄时可以选择英雄的种族、职业和个性，并掷骰决定他们的属性，与桌游一摸一样。
选择由你，命运由骰。
史诗级组队冒险
发现索拉斯塔破碎的世界，探索遗迹和地下城，寻找传奇宝藏，了解上古大灾变背后的真相，阻止灾变再临世间。借助我们的角色创建工具，按照经典桌面角色扮演游戏传统，打造专属于您的独特冒险者队伍。您可以为自己的英雄赋予鲜活的生命力，让他们的个性在对话中体现出来。您还可以按照自己偏好的战略仔细定制队伍，最大化队伍的能力。如何选择，由您决定。
在线多人合作
可与多达 4 名玩家一同畅玩所有战役——乐趣更多，计谋更多！想不想知道更精彩的？主机可以将其所有 DLC 共享给其他玩家！快点叫上朋友一起施展火球术吧。
探索神秘而多变的世界
深入失落已久的地下城，找到上古神器。不仅要当心黑暗，更要当心光明：黑暗中潜伏着许多危险不假，但光明也可能会引来怪物。有的敌人拥有黑暗视觉，有的可能会被火炬吓跑……成功的冒险者会因地制宜，夺得先机。在小队层级的回合制战术战斗中对抗怪物。《索拉斯塔》拥有动态的环境，能赋予您意想不到的战术选项。桥梁可能坍塌，让敌人孤立无援任你鱼肉；墙壁和柱子可以被推倒，如果掌握好时机和方法就能压死敌人。世界就是您的游乐试验场。
做好准备，迎接三维思考方式
《索拉斯塔》中的地下城可不是扁平的游戏面板，而是拥有三个维度。您可以攀爬、跃过或飞过障碍，也可以闪避敌人，从上方或下方杀个出其不意。想将敌人推进深渊或用东西砸扁敌人吗？没问题。想占据制高点，以优势地位展开战斗吗？随便您！尺寸也很重要。如果您的角色够瘦，就能穿过逼仄的通道，让体型更大的敌人干瞪眼。您也可以利用体型优势，爬过狭窄的隧道，发现秘密区域。巧用周围环境，找到适合您角色体型的掩体。不过别掉以轻心——怪物也拥有垂直的思维方式。
自定义战役
在《索拉斯塔》中，即使官方战役结束，你的冒险之旅也并不会停止。社区成员制作了全新自定义战役，你可以轻松下载并于好友一同畅玩！从房间的布局、怪物的组成和小队搜寻的宝藏，到每个房间的装饰，照明和音乐播放的曲目——这一切都是带着爱意制作的。

critic.quote: If you like horror, the macabre or the notion of taking a personal voyage through Dante’s Inferno with a touch of Gigeresque visuals… this may be up your alley (or down your abyssal chasm).

At the end of the day, though, Agony exists with too much dissonance to be a completely enjoyable game. For as much as I liked the visual and audio designs, and they really are pretty great, the actual gameplay is just too frustrating and dull too much of the time. I think there’s a place for games that place style over substance, but Agony doesn’t quite stick the landing.
It is dark, gritty, scary, explicit and daring. But it also is buggy, unbalanced, sometimes outright unfair and technically not as sound as it good have been.

A truly inspired and horrific depiction of Hell, attempting to prop up a mechanically nonexistent survival/horror early prototype for a game. Even the toughest of pentacle carving black metal fans will have a hard time pretending that they actually enjoyed and ‘got’ Agony.

While its bold and detailed environments depict Hell in the most nightmarish ways possible, even the fantastically obscene sights and creepy sounds become mundane and dull by the end of its series of repetitious mazes, unimaginative item hunts, and weak stealth gameplay.
As its name suggests, playing this at times is painful, void of fun, and a chore that could've been avoided had a lot more care been put into it.

s.desc:
Donut County 是一款叙事型物理解谜游戏。在游戏中，玩家将扮演地上一个不断变大的地洞。让我们一起来认识各种可爱的角色、偷偷拿走他们的垃圾并丢进地洞里。
垃圾也是宝贝
浣熊利用远程控制的垃圾偷取地洞占领了 Donut County。你将扮演操控地洞的浣熊 BK，利用地洞吞掉他的朋友们以及他们的家，以此获得各种看起来傻乎乎的奖励。
有一天，BK 不小心掉进了自己挖出的一个地洞里，并在里面遇到他最好的朋友 Mira 以及 Donut County 的居民们。他们全部被困在距离地面 999 英尺的地底之下，浣熊必须给他们一个解释！
不断变大的地洞
- 探索每个角色的家，注意看每个人的家都有着独特的环境。
- 移动地洞吞掉他们的东西，地洞会随着每次吞噬变得越来越大。
- 在地洞中组合各种物体可获得神奇的效果：熬汤、饲养兔子、发射烟火，等等。
- 将各种东西弹射到地洞外面。你可以通过这种手段来解谜...或单纯地当一个破坏王。
- 吞噬一切。在整个小镇全部消失之前，地洞将一直存在。
Donut County 是由 What Remains of Edith Finch 和 The Unfinished Swan 的设计者 Ben Esposito 创作。经历六年的独力开发，在消耗掉几十个甜甜圈（用于研究）以及与一只浣熊发生一场命中注定的邂逅之后，他终于推出了这款游戏。

critic.quote: Donut County is short. It has little to no replay value. It feels like it squanders a great deal of its potential. And yet, Donut County is still one of the best games I’ve played this year. You may only get a few hours out of Donut County, but they’re a few great hours.

Donut County is a little short and peaks prematurely and I don’t care. I’ve never played a game where I control a hungry hole, think like a trash raccoon, or talk to friendly animals at the bottom of a cave.
Donut County's gameplay doesn't offer much of a challenge, but the mechanics work as an engaging core for a game that delivers so many charming characters and genuine laughs.

Donut County is an excellent concept executed with pizzazz, personality, and an unexpectedly salient message at its core. While the end came abruptly and left me wanting more, like an endless mode or bigger levels to swallow things in, I can't deny the great time I had with what's there.
A nice little game, with emphasis on the little. You'll have a great time in its couple of hours of quirky gameplay, but that might not be enough for some, considering the price.

While the story was a non-event and there’s not nearly enough absurd hijinks happening to suit my taste, I still found Donut County to be a worthwhile experience that was hard to put down. Making things disappear into the earth like a wrathful subterranean god was cathartic in an unexpected way. I’m not sure that I can fully articulate it, but I do recommend it.

critic.quote: I'm delighted that Marble It Up! Ultra continues the trend that its predecessors set as it's one super-fun formula that'll keep you hooked.

If you’re fan of challenging arcade games and love competing for the top spots on leaderboards, it’s safe to say that Marble It Up! Ultra will absolutely be your jam. The gameplay here is simple but infectious, making you hit that retry button time and time again whether to simply finish a challenging skill-based stage or give it another go to improve your time. And thanks to weekly challenges, th

You can tell that Marble It Up! Ultra had a great foundation to build upon, as it is as polished as the marbles you roll around inside the game. The difficulty curve is satisfying, and it’s genuinely fun to improve and start lowering your times in search of unlocking more bonus levels. While it’ll appeal to players that love time trials and a challenge first and foremost, there’s a lot of charm an

Despite some small hiccups with the general presentation of the game, Marble It Up! Ultra offers a fully featured package of over 100 intricately designed obstacle courses for players to learn and overcome.

Marble It Up! Ultra applies the theory of controlled chaos to platformer design. It doles out exciting moments and frustrations in relatively equal measure thanks to the ambiguous nature of its marble physics. This unique juxtaposition often proves likable even if it can occasionally be hard to love.
Generally, the game is packed to the absolute brim with content, and it's a blast to play, even if it never sees fit to reinvent the wheel.

critic.quote: Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel is Yu-Gi-Oh! at its best. The kid gloves have been taken off to give us a complex, deep game full of exciting plays and powerful combos, but presented in a sensible and readable way, free from Joey Wheeler shoutin' about da heart o' da cards. Whether you're a veteran duelist, a lapsed player, or someone who's had a vague interest at some point in the last 25 years, this is th

Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel is an awesome game that Yu-Gi-Oh! fans, both new and old would love. I honestly would've probably given this a lower score, but they just added the option decks from YGOProDeck directly to the game. This just fixes one of the major issues of the game and warrants it a better rating. All in all, fantastic looking graphics, and it plays well. What else can you really ask from a

Konami managed to make the best Yu-gi-oh adaptation to this day that will bring many surprises to both old and new players because this game isn’t the same one we used to play 15-20 years ago. The learning curve is huge and it requires a lot of time to learn all the decks currently available, so be ready for a lot of grinds.

Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel is a free to play game designed for those who have been active in the card game for years and are looking for a space to measure themselves against other duelists from around the world. It's a deep game, with over 10,000 cards and updated rules. It's also addictive and a lot of fun, but less experienced players will struggle as they adjust to competitive play.

Master Duel is the pinnacle of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG in virtual form. It offers a ridiculous amount of tools to assist in deck customisation, and easily lets you obtain any of the thousands of cards. Where it currently falls short though is the matchmaking options, as there’s just so many variables at play from day one. This isn’t a game for new players, but it doesn’t try to be, so if you know your B

By its proposal, Duel Master clearly distinguishes itself from Duel Links, the other free-to-play in the universe of Yu-Gi-Oh!. By focusing solely on the playing card game, the title offers a very complete experience with official rules and a huge collection of cards on all media thanks to cross-platform.

critic.quote: Being a Final Fantasy fan has never been easier or more rewarding. While the mainline entries focus on pushing novelty, Final Fantasy Resonance bets on familiarity and years of learned design, delivering an experience that feels comforting yet refreshingly distinct.
There is a lot to love about Final Fantasy Resonance. Its charm is undeniable. Its great cast of characters, fantastic combat, and in depth customization help it stand out in a crowded field.

Final Fantasy Resonance may not reinvent the airship, but it incorporates every mainline Final Fantasy title—directly, as classic characters appear as Visions, or indirectly, through a story that draws from every installment. It’s a splendid celebration of the series ahead of its 40th anniversary.

Final Fantasy Resonance manages to transform its nod to the past into something more than a mere nostalgic exercise. The return to turn-based combat, the Stagger and Visions systems, and a highly refined HD-2D art style deliver a classic JRPG experience that feels anything but dated. Certain design choices—such as random encounters, backgrounds that don’t always hit the mark, and, most notably, th

The mix of new and old in FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE makes for an engaging story with a visceral battle system and a world that's a joy to explore. However, I wish the visions mechanic was more central to the game and its writing can be eye-rolling at parts.

Final Fantasy Resonance is well-suited for both veterans of the franchise and newcomers to the JRPG genre. The gameplay is entertaining and varied. Visually, however, the stylishly designed HD-2D graphics alternate with 3D sequences that seem somewhat out of place.

critic.quote: I hope this is the moment where Team Ninja is finally acknowledged as not only a driving force in the Soulslike genre, but for its name to be ranked amongst the best. Nioh 3 is an unbelievable game from start to finish and excels in all aspects of game development.

It may not replace Elden Ring in my heart, but Nioh 3 is a new high bar for the series and one of the most engaging and exciting Soulslikes I've had the fortune of playing. Top-of-the-line combat and a brand-new and surprisingly engaging open world make it a fantastic place to start for newcomers or longtime franchise fans alike. Aside from a somewhat weak plot, there's nothing holding back Nioh 3

Nioh 3 doesn’t settle for iterative improvements. Instead, it pulls together Team Ninja’s best mechanics from past entries, folds in welcome touches from its other games, and backs it all up with genuinely strong new additions that feel mechanically sound and consistently engaging.

You don’t change a winning team, as they say. Except that you absolutely can replace a winning team with an even stronger one. These 60 hours spent with Nioh 3 have done more than dispel our doubts—they’ve shown us that every change introduced by Koei Tecmo was conceived with exceptional care and relevance. Nioh 3 has become an exploration game, and it feels like this was its calling from the very

Nioh 3 may not be the peak of the series, but it remains a strong title that understands what makes Nioh special. For fans, it’s an experience worth diving into. For newcomers, it’s a deeply rewarding introduction. And for me, it’s another reminder of why this series still stands above most Soulslikes chasing the same crown.

Nioh 3 is the culmination of Team Ninja's three previous souls-like games, pushing each aspect a little further. While not entirely perfect, it is steadily approaching perfection. It is one of the must-have souls-like games for any fan of the genre.

Its immersive world, unique mechanics, engaging gameplay, and compelling story have set a new standard of what a good ARPG should look like and are bound to appeal to almost everyone.

Zenless Zone Zero blends simple-yet-stylish combat with a soundtrack that spans decades of musical flair. But although its audiovisual polish is outstanding and its combat is simple yet challenging, its shallow support roles and the removal of its unique exploration mode hold the game back.
A new gacha game full of charm and high class characters with a fun and dynamic gameplay. But it's the mix of inspirations that makes up the universe that really catches the eye.

Obviously, if the gachas and the character and equipment obtaining system in the other Hoyoverse titles don't appeal to you, then it certainly won't be Zenless Zone Zero that will change your mind - but, beyond that, this new title is certainly a more than valid action RPG that underlines the great awareness achieved by Hoyoverse, which only moves when it is sure of hitting the mark.

Zenless Zone Zero is style and is substance, a game with hypnotic action not only because of its visual accomplishments, but also because of how addictive is its gameplay. If HoYoverse properly supports it in the future, then this will be the studio's third victory.

Zenless Zone Zero is a snappy action game that feels rewarding to master. Though the story can fall flat at times, the characters are so fun that it’s fun to see their reactions. s.desc:

《漫威金刚狼》是由《漫威蜘蛛侠》系列开发商Insomniac Games打造的热血动作冒险游戏。作品与Marvel Games强强联手，呈现一段围绕传奇漫画角色金刚狼展开的全新原创故事。
罗根以为自己已经与“金刚狼”这个身份告别，可他的过去仍不肯放过他。
三年前，他离开了变种人特别行动X小队。如今，在X小队最黑暗的时刻，金刚狼归队。
一心奉行人类至上理念的玻利瓦尔·特拉斯克开始大肆绑架变种人。能救他们的，只有金刚狼。
为了变种人的未来，金刚狼必须与世界各地的变种人并肩作战，足迹遍及加拿大、日本，以及漫威宇宙中的岛国马德里坡。
人类与变种人的命运悬于一线。罗根知道，这个世界需要一位英雄。可惜他们只能将就一下，指望金刚狼了。
化身金刚狼
释放金刚狼炸裂凶狠的战斗本能，以锋利无比的艾德曼合金利爪撕碎敌人，用迅猛流畅的连击突破不可能的绝境。借助独特且可切换的技能与异能，迎战玻利瓦尔·特拉斯克手下的雇佣兵掠夺者，以及红色欧米伽这类粗暴蛮横的经典反派。追踪、潜伏，或是以绝对力量碾碎他们！保持攻势，积累怒气，把敌人撕成碎片。因为金刚狼做事从来不讲温柔。
全新原创故事，情绪张力十足
在粗粝外表与暴躁脾气之下，金刚狼还是一个会为了更大使命而战的男人。变种人正遭遇灭顶之灾，而能为他们杀出一线生机的，只有他。直面黑暗过往，体验一段围绕身份、忠诚与自我挣扎展开的动人故事，追寻金刚狼失落记忆背后的真相。
横跨全球的高燃旅程
从冰封的加拿大荒野，到东京狭窄的街巷，再到岛国马德里坡上下城区。金刚狼挥舞利爪，杀穿一处处细节丰富的战场。在这场横跨全球、关乎变种人生死存亡的战斗中，见证金刚狼一路上的震撼时刻。

critic.quote: Marvel’s Wolverine… what a ride! Insomniac has successfully honoured the core of Wolverine and translated it into one of the best games of 2026. From the very first moments of the game, you are taken on a jaw-dropping and adrenaline-pumping adventure as you slice and dice your way through an army of enemies as you try to save the world from those seeking to control it. From its flawless gameplay t

I might be accused of being a bit of a fanboy, but I expect excellence from PlayStation exclusives, and for me, Marvel's Wolverine fell just short of that mark. It is a game that derives its strength from a powerful narrative, story, and cast of characters, backed by deeply satisfying combat, yet it doesn't offer much else. While it can be repetitive and occasionally feels a bit hollow, it ultimat
An epic, brutal and visual stunning game that shines in its bossfights and where lineair progression works, but also where Insomniac doesn't seem to trust the intelligence of the gamer.

Marvel’s Wolverine is an explosive, fiery comic book video game that wears its gratuitous violence as a refreshing badge of honour. Sadly, the violence’s vehicle, the game’s combat, amounts to little more than mindless slashing, waning a while before the game’s credits roll. Its narrative, which does peak in the final act, shows flashes of heart in an otherwise predictable, paint-by-numbers arc. I

Marvel’s Wolverine combines a dark and dramatic narrative with bloody combat and outstanding visuals. Insomniac Games crafts a story centered on the past, rage, and personal conflicts of Marvel’s most solitary mutant, accompanied by familiar faces. However, its linear world and story structure, repetitive gameplay and simplistic mechanics leave the feeling that it could have offered much more. Alt

This is a turn-your-brain-off-and-go-for-a-ride spectacle that occasionally punches above its weight. That works to some extent, but Marvel's Wolverine doesn't live up to the creative standard Insomniac Games is known for, and Logan has never been known for playing it safe.

The first version of Diablo 4 is a canvas on which the developers could, over the months, paint a true masterpiece. The equipment and progression system is extremely robust and lends itself well to the significant innovations that the team plans to implement in the production lifecycle, through patches and expansions. If Blizzard manages to keep the attention high on the title and make the right c

Theory-crafters, lore hounds and newcomers can all find something to love about Diablo 4 — as long as their interests converge on beating demons to death. critic.quote: Flight Simulator 2024 is an interesting title not only for aviation enthusiasts, but also for players who want to explore the world from above and admire its beauty. The new title has many attractive features, such as photography, different pilot jobs and new types of aircraft, including balloons and airships. It's just a shame that the game often uploads additional data.
Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 fulfills the promise of being the most true-to-life and detailed game of its kind.

Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is undeniably ambitious, but its execution feels more like a modest upgrade than a revolutionary sequel. In many ways, it feels like a tweaked, cloud-streamed version of Flight Simulator 2020, with only minor changes to the core gameplay. That said, the addition of casual-friendly features such as entertainment-focused modes and a structured career system provide a

Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is a diamond in the rough, still waiting to be fully discovered. Despite launch issues and some questionable technical decisions, the game offers a great concept that can be enjoyed by both veteran simulation enthusiasts and newcomers to this type of experience. Straddling the line between video game and simulator, its greatest strength is also its main flaw, given

Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is a game with huge potential, using stunning advanced technology and stunning visuals. It aims to provide a one-to-one representation of Earth, complete with full virtual reality support. However, its launch has had technical issues like non-functioning servers, long loading times, crashes, and bugs. Despite this, the game's engaging career mode and breathtaking ex

Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 offers enough innovations to justify its arrival, with an impressive career mode and endless options to lose yourself in the skies for hours. However, weak localization, clunky AI voices, and long loading times show that perfection is not yet within reach.

critic.quote: This is demanding work, but the game’s distinct but complementary loops of playful labour are highly compelling. The satisfaction of completing a challenging dive without needing to be rescued, then watching the rave reviews on “Cooksta” pour in, is profound. Stylish, witty and exquisitely designed, Dave the Diver uses several hooks to achieve its goal, while establishing the relationship between
Whether you're diving into the depths or managing a sushi restaurant, Dave the Diver is full of ideas and engaging from start to finish.

Dave the Diver is a surprisingly excellent game. Its beautiful pixel art is joined by plenty of activities, not very deep, but fun all the same. The weird underwater world is charming and invites discovery. The characters are interesting, with memorable quests. The tempo is a bit unequal sometimes, but the game offers plenty of content nonetheless.

There’s basically nothing to find fault with in Dave the Diver. Did I have trouble mastering a few of the cooking minigames, and an easy mode for the rhythm games would have been appreciated – but that’s a drop in the ocean compared to what it does right. Filling out the fish index, sneaking through a secret base, gambling in a merfolk casino – everywhere I turned there was something new to try, a
Dave The Diver will end up being one of those fundamental titles that people talk about in the same breath as Stardew Valley, where it achieves on nearly every front.

Games are often referred to as mixing the right ingredients and mixing the best recipe. But in the case of Dave the diver, the ingredients and recipes on the plate are the most important thing, not metaphorically, but completely practically. And the resulting food tastes so good that you will lick your fingers.

critic.quote: A very few games can compare to Kakarot in terms of sheer love towards the original series and storytelling qualities. Not without its set of flaws that leave only regret not being even greater, Kakarot still manages to be a great game for fans. No, scratch that. It manages to be an amazing game! May they not stop here, and deliver more and more of love-letters like this. If it goes in the right d

Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot is the best way to get acquainted with the Saiyan saga and the series in general. It's strange that the most advertised mechanics of the game, the RPG and open-world aspects, are also the least developed. It's the story and the bombastic fights where Kakarot really shines, so if you're approaching the game from these perspectives, you're in for a thrilling ride. To put it bl

Kakarot is one of the games based on this manga we’ve enjoyed the most. It’s a fantastic adventure, and even if it’s not perfect, it’s made by fans for fans. If you are one of those kids who sit in front of the TV waiting for the next episode to air, you’ll enjoy every second of it.

Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot is a fantastic avenue for new and casual fans alike, providing a deeper level of insight and immersion into a beloved franchise. However, more seasoned veterans of the series may not be as easily impressed. Fluid, fast, and visually stunning combat combined with some intriguing ideas gives Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot plenty to root for, but it still doesn’t feel as fleshed out an

Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot's modern, semi-open approach to telling the saga of DBZ--despite some minor issues--is a good one. Zooming around the environments and seeing the world up close is a blast, and it's great being able to interact with so many fun DBZ characters and see stories that usually get passed over for game adaptations. And even though combat can be a bit lacking, when the big battles h

Despite the numerous flaws, Kararot still offers a wonderful retelling of the main story, above-average graphics, and a great soundtrack, so it’s worth picking up for established and new fans of the series alike.

BeamNG.drive 是一款非常逼真的模拟驾驶游戏，拥有近乎无限的可能。我们的软体物理引擎可以实时模拟车辆的各个部件，达到与现实相同的效果。经过多年的精心设计、深入研究与丰富体验，BeamNG.drive 真实地还原了在现实世界中驾驶车辆的乐趣。
为什么 BeamNG.drive 是最适合您的游戏?
软体物理系统：BeamNG 的物理引擎是整个游戏的核心，能够为您带来原汁原味、前所未有的车辆模拟体验。游戏使用了非常精准的损伤模型，车辆碰撞的感觉无比真实。
车辆： BeamNG.drive 提供了几十种完全可自定义的精致车辆。无论是小型车辆还是大型卡车，您都可以调整所有的可操控部件，打造您梦想中的驾驶体验。车轮、悬挂、引擎等等... 一切尽在您的掌控之中。
环境： 驾驶途中您将会有许多奇妙的发现。12+ 个广阔无垠、景色秀丽的开放世界等您探索，复杂的地形与游戏设置一样变化多样。您可以在热带丛林小径、荒芜沙漠、城市大道和拥挤的高速公路等各种地方中测试您调试好的新车。
更多内容
游戏模式： 这款游戏不仅能给您带来普通的驾驶模拟体验。游戏内还有各种异彩纷呈的玩法选项，您既可以完成简单的运送任务，也可以创建一个完整的地图，以用来测试您新打造的座驾。

- 计时赛：选择一款车辆、环境与路线，检验您的驾驶技巧！磨炼您的技术，不断挑战自己，刷新最佳时间记录。
自由度： BeamNG.drive 与其他汽车游戏不同的地方就在于，它给予了玩家很高的自由度。在这款游戏中，您可以用汽车或卡车做几乎任何您能想到的事情，并以最接近现实的方式看到事情的结果。您可以使用我们的软体物理引擎和自定义功能，制作出几乎任何想要的场景。这款游戏不仅能为您提供丰富的车辆，您还能利用可自定义的广阔开放世界打造自己梦想中的驾驶体验。业界领先的物理系统、无限可能的自定义内容与紧密团结的社区，BeamNG.drive 一定是您游玩过的最细致完整、最妙趣横生的车辆模拟游戏。
抢先体验：BeamNG.drive 即将在 PlayStation 平台推出抢先体验版。这代表游戏仍在积极开发中，玩家可以在开发团队持续改进和扩展游戏体验的过程中，亲身见证其演变过程。在抢先体验期间购买游戏的玩家，既能抢先探索逼真的物理引擎、各种车辆和玩法，还能通过提供反馈帮助塑造游戏未来的开发方向。

critic.quote: Street Fighter 6 honestly feels like the best game of the series in every facet possible. The long term will prove or disprove this though as these games tend to morph and change over their lifetime. But for this game to take that title, it’s done everything right from the outset to cement its legacy as the best of the best. This game is a recommendation for people interested in fighting games at

Capcom may have made significant mistakes in the development of Street Fighter V, but it’s clear they were determined not to repeat them with Street Fighter 6. I can’t remember the last time a fighting game offered such a complete package, with something for every type of player. Combine that with best-in-class mechanics and a visual identity that truly sets it apart, and Street Fighter 6 is every

Capcom once again sets a new standard for 2D fighting games. In addition to the advanced combat system and the excellent package of single-player modes, made up of numerous elements that find their balance in sharing the same resource (the Drive indicator), SF6 counts on more than a vast group of tutorials and alternative control schemes for every need.

This is not only a kinetic, exciting and gloriously refined interpretation of the most storied fighting game series, but also the most generous and expansive offering yet. Here is a game that pays tearful tribute to its past, while determinedly seeking out a new and young audience - mindful, no doubt, that its future resides in their hands, be they practised or otherwise. [Issue #386, p.100]
Street Fighter 6 comes out of its corner swinging and delivers a three-hit combo of modes that will leave fight fans floored.
For fans of the series, Street Fighter 6 is an insta-buy. It’s an easy recommendation for fighting game fans at large too.

critic.quote: Prepare for anger, fear, pain and disappointment. As clichéd as it may sound, Naughty Dog has reached a new, seemingly unreachable level of narrative design. The Last of Us Part II will hurt you in ways that no game has ever done before. This is a story you must experience. [08/2020, p.36]

The Last of Us Part II is a third person action game, a survival horror, an immersive sim, a walking Simulator, and snippets of so many others, all at the same time. Without the immensity of an open world, it masterfully emulates the sense of freedom, and without the classic features of an RPG, it has allowed us to make the characters our own. Or rather, the other way around. It is an evolution fo

The entire package is wrapped together in a gorgeous presentation that serves as Naughty Dog’s PS4 swan song. The Last of Us Part II’s harrowing tale and exploration of violence may not leave everyone happy by the time the credits roll, but it’s another stunning home run for Naughty Dog.
Naughty Dog delivers their best game yet –an exceptional game in every aspect. It is an incredibly shocking, epic, terrifying action adventure with an unforgettable story.

Not everyone is going to enjoy the motives of The Last of Us Part II. But if you try and manage to accept the subliminal and not so subtle messages as a fact that the world has gone awry and that people have the need to have somewhere or someone to belong to as their own way out, then... You will witness the boundaries of gaming expand. You will witness a true masterpiece.

If you enjoyed the first TLOU, you'll definitely find something to love in The Last of Us Part II. The game greatly expands upon just about everything that made the first game popular. The second game didn't get to me emotionally like the first game did, but it definitely has some heavy moments and the shock value is rather extreme at some points.

s.desc:
《雾锁王国》是一款单人/合作生存动作RPG，在这里，你的自由与创造力将被摆在第一位。竭尽全力战胜蚕食薪谷王国的腐化瘴气：探索手工打造的瑰丽世界，揭开隐藏的秘密并披荆斩棘开辟道路，在完全支持地形改造的世界中尽情建造。
崛起吧，火之子
从漫长沉睡中苏醒，如今你已经成为陨落王国最后的希望。利用颇具深度的技能树系统打造与众不同的英雄：重装坦克、致命游侠、毁灭天地的战斗法师，亦或是通过灵活组合来创造只属于你的游玩风格。
探索充满野性魅力的广袤世界
领略令人心旷神怡的景色并揭示来自陨落文明的秘密。穿越生机盎然的森林、烈日炙烤的沙丘、白雪皑皑的高山与被瘴气笼罩的遗迹。使用抓钩跨越深不见底的沟壑、从令人头晕目眩的高度一跃而下并尽情滑翔、或者潜入水下以探索各种意想不到的地点。
生存与成长
发掘大自然的馈赠——狩猎、耕作、垂钓并寻觅稀有材料。拯救深陷瘴气之中的幸存者，见证最初的孤独小屋逐渐发展成工匠与居民熙攘不休的热闹村落，并借此解锁一系列的全新配方与装备。只有懂得未雨绸缪与随机应变之人才能真正求得生存。
不拘一格的战斗
不断积累实力并打倒原本不可一世的强敌。挥舞大剑、施放毁灭性魔法、钻研独门绝技或者组合不同类型的技艺，基于技能的战斗与天赋系统方便上手但又富有深度。
真正自由的建造
在薪谷中留下你的痕迹，只有你想不到，没有你造不出来的。凭借自己的双手让一座座威严要塞拔地而起，或者是在悬崖峭壁上修建世外桃源，随心所欲改造地形并根据自己的喜好精心装饰每一个房间。基于体素的建造系统意味着你将拥有极致的自由，这个世界就是你的家园。
征服瘴气
反击的时刻终于到来。深入威胁万物生灵的致命浓雾。面对最凶残的生物、获取前所未有的稀有材料并一步步从瘴气的魔掌中拯救薪谷。
铸就你的传奇 - 单打独斗或结伴同行
独自踏上这段旅程，或者加入至多8名玩家的合作游戏。战斗、建造、耕种或探索：重建王国需要每一个人的力量。
探索永无止境的冒险
通关战役并不是你的故事的终点。深入由数以百万计玩打造的精美世界与地牢，或者通过我们的“冒险分享”功能与他人分享自己的创意。

系列第2部作品《人中之龙２》以龙引擎完全重制的作品——《人中之龙 极２》登场！
曾经被称为“堂岛之龙”的传说中的男人——桐生一马和被称为“关西之龙”的最强黑道——乡田龙司，

为了拯救如今已然弱化的东城会，桐生决定赶往大阪。而等待他的是被称为“关西之龙”的最强黑道——乡田龙司，以及“狩猎黑道的女人”——狭山薰。

■额外的故事“真岛吾朗的真相”！
可以了解到发生在《人中之龙》与《人中之龙２》之间的故事。

s.desc:
化身为令人生畏的海盗
作为“寒鸦号”的船长爱德华·肯威，你将在登船接舷、击沉敌舰的过程中，让你的敌人闻风丧胆。无论是在人群中隐匿行踪，还是带头冲锋陷阵，你都能在潜行暗杀与硬核格斗间无缝切换，自如挥洒长剑、火枪与袖剑。你将与多位名震青史的海盗传奇并肩作战，在刺客组织与圣殿骑士跨越时代的宿命对决中，勇敢地对抗帝国霸权。
经典重塑，为你带来升级体验
战斗系统已全面重制，突出招架与处决，让对抗体验更具动感。同时，潜行与跑酷系统也得到了优化，使暗杀行动更利落，逃脱过程更丝滑。你还可以不断升级“寒鸦号”，凭借更具深度的海战机制和新增的次要射击模式，去挑战那些更为强大的敌舰。增加多项游戏质量优化，针对性地解决了以往体验中的痛点，确保冒险过程更加顺畅舒心。
加勒比海焕然一新
无论是在波澜壮阔的大海上扬帆远航，还是在荒野丛林中穿梭探索，你都能在这个由最新 Anvil 引擎打造的无缝开放世界中，感受极致的流畅与真实。你可以尽情领略壮阔的奇观，无论是搏击惊涛骇浪，潜入深海探寻沉船残骸，还是穿行于茂密的热带雨林，一切美景尽收眼底。在杜比全景声与光线追踪技术的加持下，每一处场景都更具沉浸感，令这个世界的绝美景观跃然眼前。
拓展爱德华的冒险篇章
在原版故事的基础上，《刺客信条：黑旗 记忆重置》引入了专属的全新内容。还有熟悉的面孔重返舞台，黑胡子和施帝德‧邦尼特等深受粉丝喜爱的角色也将迎来专属的全新剧情线。在意想不到的盟友助力下，你的旅程将不再孤单——三名新军官将作为主线剧情的一部分，正式加入你的阵营。更多惊喜正等着你，包括全新的船歌、宠物、拍照模式等丰富内容。
使用在线功能需要网络连接、Ubisoft 账号和 PlayStation™Network 账号。

critic.quote: Everything you loved about Black Flag is there but just refined, polished and re-wrapped with the biggest changes coming in the smaller mechanics to make the whole story feel more fluid.

With modern controls and some smart changes, Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced brings the classic into the current AC era, smoothing out the wrinkles of the original game. With its sprawling and beautiful Caribbean ocean, Resynced wisely doesn't overwhelm the player with tasks, instead leaning into a fun but unobtrusive story that can be ignored for hours in favor of some rewarding exploration.

Black Flag Resynced marks the return of a great Assassin’s Creed game, but more importantly, the return of a true adventure. It is the kind of game that makes you want to set sail, explore, hunt for treasure, watch the sun go down over the ocean, and remember why Black Flag remains such a special entry in the series even today.

Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced successfully modernizes one of the best titles in the series thanks to impressive audiovisuals and new content. However, beneath that revamp lies a design inherited from 2013 that shows its age. Even so, it remains a fun, solid pirate adventure that comes highly recommended for both veterans and new players.

The game’s old strengths hold firm. The depth and variety of Edward’s day-to-day life still delights – one day he’s upgrading the manor at his private cove, the next he’s clambering Incan ruins for Templar treasure. Primary quests are well-paced, well-acted, and have a knack for making you feel heroic. But in the end, it’s the moments in between that make this game special. It’s when you’re sailin

Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced is a great remake of a game that probably didn't need to be remade. Of all the games in the AC franchise, Black Flag holds up better than many, but that doesn't change the fact that I had a wonderful time going back. The cast, setting and atmosphere are still some of the best ever realised in the series, and the new content feels right at home.

s.desc:
《Dune: Awakening 沙丘：觉醒》支持单人及多人模式，是一款开放世界生存游戏，融合了沉浸式冒险和角色扮演玩法。探索、建造、制作，在宇宙最传奇的星球上，从求生崛起为传奇，一步步揭开一段电影级别的沙丘故事。
记住：沙虫从不缺席。
探索沙丘广阔的开放世界
探索动态且充满沉浸感的厄拉科斯，从沙漠腹地连绵起伏的沙丘，到隐秘的弗雷曼人洞穴，再到厄拉奇恩繁忙的街道。用志贺藤钩攀上陡峭的高山，乘坐自己打造的扑翼机飞越沙虫横行的沙漠。躲避高耸入云的巨型沙暴扫荡大地，然后在夕阳低垂时，静静欣赏厄拉科斯的美景。
体验一段史诗电影般的沙丘故事
在《Dune: Awakening 沙丘：觉醒》中，玩家将步入原著与电影，近距离体验科幻史上最不可思议的世界之一。加入厄崔迪或哈克南阵营，在探索他们独特故事的同时步步高升。与雷托公爵、菲得-罗萨等熟悉角色相遇，调查弗雷曼人神秘失踪的真相，并挖掘自己的过往之谜。一段宏大、电影般的沙丘故事就此拉开帷幕，它提出了一个令人脑洞大开的问题：如果保罗·厄崔迪从未出生，故事将会如何发展？
成为战斗与生存大师
在厄拉科斯生存是一场少有人能活下来的试炼。而活下来的人，将觉醒。学会在厄拉科斯特有的环境下生存：追逐阴凉，从敌人身上提取体液，再炼成水。研习帝国各大学派的技艺，解锁强大的能力、武器和工具。发挥步兵的压倒性火力，用贝尼杰瑟里特的音言控制敌人，布置门泰特的欺诈陷阱，或精通剑术大师那独一无二的死亡之舞。
建造堡垒，制作扑翼机
在厄拉科斯开疆拓土，打造你的个人行动基地。从小型哨站到高耸入云的宏伟堡垒，全都由你亲手一块块搭建。选择厄崔迪风、哈克南风或其他建筑风格，并用装饰来体现你的个性。装备上强力制造机和香料精炼厂，看你的实力与财富与日俱增。可制造的东西从实用的沙漠生存道具，到地面车和扑翼机这类完整的载具，应有尽有。
单人、多人模式，难度可调
独自游玩完整的单人模式，与好友在共享服务器上联机，或在公共服务器上与数百名玩家同场竞技。所有模式均包含完整游戏内容、功能与剧情。单人模式与私人多人服务器均提供丰富的自定义选项，可让你随心调整难度和游戏设置。

If you can get past all the posturing and over-the-top woo-hooing, Riders Republic is a very good extreme sports game.

这是超级地球公民与生俱来的权利，是我们文明的重要支柱，

这场战争的胜负成败取决于每个参与者的每一分努力。

critic.quote: I'm blown away by the feel of the game and just how much fun it is to play online by myself and with my brothers. The leveling up system, replayability, variety of the missions, and the story have made it worth dusting off my DualSense controller.
Helldivers 2 is a testament to the power of teamwork and tactical gameplay, wrapped in a satirical package that's hard to put down.

Helldivers II from developer Arrowhead Game Studios is a team-driven experience that is goal-driven fun wrapped in a goofy Starship Troopers tip of the hat. While the gameplay can get repetitive, the reward system helps to balance it out.

I had an exceptional amount of fun with HELLDIVERS 2 and will happily boot it up whenever I want to experience some frantic co-op shooting action. Throw in a superb sense of humour and oodles of rewarding unlockables and you're left with a cape-worthy offering.

Helldivers 2 is extremely silly. It’s utterly over the top, and it’s not very deep, but GOOD GOD, I have had a ball with it this past week. Its general simplicity may end up dooming it to be a short-lived flash in the pan… But what a brilliantly bright flash it would be.
Helldivers 2 is an excellent co-op shooter that lacks a bit of variety in the long run despite many unlock options.

s.desc:
传奇制作人 “吹哥” Jonathan Blow（代表作：《时空幻境》《见证者》）携新作《沉星之序》重磅归来。这款宏大的冒险游戏内含 1000 多个手工设计的谜题，旨在考验你的智慧极限。你将踏入充满奇异魔法、危险机关与凶残怪物的异界，探索四个机制迥异、角色鲜明、故事独立的平行世界，最终见证它们彼此交汇碰撞的壮丽景象。随着世界融合、角色相遇，谜题系统也将相互交织，催生出意想不到的全新玩法。按自己的节奏自由探索，随时重返各个世界与挑战。解锁独特的可操作角色，掌握不断演变的游戏机制，逐步剥开这片广阔互联世界的深层秘密。融合探索、叙事与持续蜕变的机制，《沉星之序》将为你呈现一场前所未有、充满生命力的谜境之旅。
数千谜题，交织成篇
踏上这场创意十足的谜题冒险，体验数十种游戏机制与数百小时的独特玩法。每一个谜题都承前启后，引入全新机制，回报你的好奇心与坚持。
自由探索，随心漫游
探索四个庞大而神秘的世界，每个世界都有专属的角色、规则、险境与待发掘的秘密。来去随心，按自己的节奏应对眼前的一切谜题。
化身风格迥异的英雄
女王、盗贼、战士、巫师、乃至一艘会说话的小船……都将是这段传奇的英雄。每位角色都拥有相辅相成的能力与引人入胜的故事。
破解史诗级的谜团
随着角色相遇、世界相互碰撞，谜团逐渐揭晓。通过谜题与收集散落的笔记，你将一步步深入了解这个神秘国度。借助每一条线索、每一片拼图，最终揭开《沉星之序》的终极秘密。

Its four distinct worlds, character-driven limitations, and increasingly intertwined mechanics make solving puzzles deeply satisfying, even if prolonged roadblocks can sometimes become exhausting.

Order of the Sinking Star is a brilliant puzzle game that offers over a thousand intricate yet accessible challenges, capable of keeping players entertained for hundreds of hours. Its clever design and timeless appeal make it a great experience for both puzzle enthusiasts and casual players. It is one of the best puzzle games of the decade.

There’s no doubt that Order of the Sinking Star is one of the best puzzle games out there. The continual evolution of mechanics sprawling across a puzzle-ridden overworld is vast and exciting, and it’s so cool to see it all come from the same core concept. I like that it tells different stories within this, which leads to the bigger mystery of where we are to begin with. Sometimes it can feel a li

Order of the Sinking Star is a great puzzle game created by one of the most celebrated creators working in the genre. It delivers four core worlds, each with a unique cast and a defining mechanic, and challenges players to find solutions while unlocking new challenges that will blend different gameplay elements. The lack of a clear hint system will lead to frustration for some, especially once the

I want to turn the mirrors back onto the positives of Order of the Sinking Star, because it is such a marvel. I am yet to play anything like it. It’s so laden with riches that it’s embarrassing, as the saying goes.

Order of the Sinking Star is the most unique puzzle game I’ve ever encountered. Seemingly endless innovation and evolution of mechanics are just some of the key aspects of this game. While it doesn’t always hit the mark in terms of story delivery or length, it maintains its unusual gameplay throughout the many hours of gameplay. If you’re a fan of puzzles, then there’s never been a game more made

s.desc:
向探寻未来的旅途，迈步前进吧。
两人为寻回重要的东西，在失落的故乡寻找真相——
【故事】
曾因矿山和贸易而繁荣一时的城镇“赫尔芬”，遭遇了一场几乎让全体居民消失的神秘灾害，从此沦为禁地。
岁月流转，封锁终于解除，复兴计划也提上日程。
当年被迫离乡的少女与少年，如今已长大成人，怀着不同的目的重归故里。
命运的指引下，两人在故土相逢，携手踏上探寻真相的旅程。
殊不知在前方等待他们的，是超乎想象的邂逅与真相——
【场景】
在“兰塔纳大陆”无拘无束自由冒险，感受昼夜流转与风云变幻的独特风光。
地图与魔物配置随挑战随机刷新的层级式“亚空之道”，难度越高，稀有素材的回报也越丰厚。
以更优质的调合素材为目标，勇敢挑战“亚界之道”吧！
【战斗】
战斗为极具策略性的时间条指令战斗。
前卫与后卫最多三人一组，通过多重行动、道具混搭以及合作攻击等全新要素，带来更加畅快淋漓的战斗体验！
【调合】
本作采用连接素材固有的“天赋颜色”来制作道具的“天赋颜色调合”系统。
除必要素材外，最多可添加三种素材为道具赋予特性，简单易上手的同时，亦不失深度！
通过“配方变化”和“天赋颜色”制造新道具，活用可改变投入素材种类的“活性素材”功能，打造最强道具！
【城镇发展/商店经营】
在自己的商店内贩卖“调合”制成的道具，推动城镇的发展吧！
通过贩卖各种各样的道具赚取资金，再将受益投入城镇建设来推动发展。
随着城镇日益繁盛，不仅能获得新的调合配方，还能推进主线剧情。

critic.quote: If it isn’t already clear enough by this point, Atelier Resleria is an excellent RPG. From battle system to alchemy to multiple other subsystems, everything seemed superbly planned and polished. No previous experience with the Atelier series is necessary to enjoy all this game has to offer, but returning fans will receive plenty of nostalgic dopamine hits. This is a game that shows how a familiar

If you have a big heart, love cuteness, and want to be immersed in a bubbly game world teeming with upstanding welcoming characters then Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian is an RPG that you have to play even if it can be a bit simple gameplay-wise.
Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian brings enough new features to its historical formula to keep us hooked for hours on end. A good episode, original and addictive.

Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian surprised me with how confidently it balances tradition and evolution, offering one of the most thoughtfully built entries in the franchise to date. While some systems remain overly rigid, the expanded narrative scope, satisfying synthesis, and nuanced protagonists make it a rewarding return for longtime fans, and a solid entry point for n

Overall, while Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian doesn’t provide a shockingly different or awe-inspiring experience, it is still a respectable and enjoyable entry in the Atelier series.

Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian succeeds through the strength of the sum of its parts. Its story and dialogue are a bit obtrusive at points, but the simple loop of fashioning items to flog them to forge even better ones is compelling. With strategic turn-based combat and breezy presentation, this is an overall enjoyable RPG time sink – even if its character designs and a

The story is okay, but what really stands out are the alchemy system, the battle system, and especially the music. critic.quote: Stakes and tensions run high whether playing solo or in a group, but the game truly shines when you’re working with a coherent team, so pick this game up and find one.

There's a lot of depth and strategy to be found in Rainbow Six: Siege, especially when you're playing with a headset. However, the lack of content is something to be considered when pondering the game's retail price.
An FPS where your weapon should be the last thing you use, not the first, Rainbow Six Siege is a fantastic tactical shooter.

The gameplay is solid as a rock; super intense, exciting and porn for the tactical shooter fan. But the game quickly loses its power when you stray among the other game modes, which are limited and lacking good AI. This is what they call: too little content for too much money. [Dec. 2015, p.054]
Siege is both unforgivably callow and inarguably satisfying. Like parades or fireworks, it’s a vision that’s only fun if you can forget where it comes from and where it points to.

Siege can feel cool and inhospitable, but when the conditions are right and you're playing with friends, the game's tense gameplay and measured pacing makes for a refreshing, cerebral contrast to the run-and-gun hyperactivity of most online shooters. [Feb 2016, p.104]

critic.quote: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla is another success in the series. We love that it’s starting to look back at older, more classic elements of the franchise and finding ways to reimplement them in an ever-evolving, fresh feeling new game.

Assassin's Creed Valhalla takes the advancements of the series found in Odyssey and applies it to a whole new setting. As brutal as the period of Vikings is, there's something beautiful about this adventure. Every action is rewarded with some great moments of storytelling, and aside from a few narrative roadblocks tied to the player's level, there's an amazing world here just waiting to be discove

If it sufficiently renews the experience of the saga thanks to a rich and functional overall design and an approach that should delight fans of the first hour, Assassin's Creed Valhalla also retains some stigmas of its predecessors that prevent it from aiming a little higher.

It is undeniable that the series is growing, and it’s admirable that the developers are willing to try new things. Overall, the experience works in Assassin’s Creed Valhalla. It’s not a perfect fit, yet, but there’s promise in the series future if they continue to head in a direction that has more RPG elements, and options for a direct approach. It also feels like a proof of concept that they can

Those are minor nitpicks of course, and shouldn't take away from all of the things Valhalla does well. Valhalla builds one of the most immersive and lived-in worlds of the series so far and expertly ties in all of its various mechanics and elements into one delightfully fulfilling experience. It delivers thrilling action and a gratifying narrative while also giving older concepts like the settleme

Valhalla once again proves that ubisoft's chosen path for Assassin's Creed may not be appealing to the old fans of the series, and that's not necessarily a bad thing, as the series have developed into a solid RPG franchise. Still, Valhalla shows that the series is still far from completion, as there are several obvious shortcomings in combat gameplay and AI, along with some visual problems.

users.author: PiggySpartan
users.quote: This game was incredible, the world and exploration are arguably one of the best in AC series. In my opinion, this game is less of an RPG than Odyssey and the best RPG entry in the trilogy. The story is great and the combat is very fun and enjoyable. s.desc:
在《RuneScape》被遗忘的大陆——烬落之地，龙族已然苏醒。在这款多人合作生存冒险游戏中，收集资源、建造家园、修炼技能、打造道具。唯有精通生存之道、揭开远古秘辛，才有资格直面凶残的龙之女王。
经典符文，本源回归！
承接剧情任务、修炼各项技能，探索这片匠心雕琢的绝美世界。
全新冒险篇章登陆新大陆，融合奇幻风格与《符文世界》经典世界观底蕴。RPG成长体系会随你的技能进阶，赠予专属天赋和法术能力。迎战僵尸食人魔等《符文世界》经典传奇生物，挑战黑骑士势力，还有全新登场的恐怖加鲁族群。全程配以重新编曲的《符文世界》经典配乐，以及数小时全新原创恢弘乐章。
磨练技能，斩杀巨龙
追踪巨龙踪迹，毅然发起挑战，踏出通往龙之女王的征途。
当你整装备战、决意挺身而出时，巨龙的阴影始终笼罩着你的前路。追寻毁灭的踪迹，揭开这片大陆的神秘面纱，不仅要学习如何对抗巨龙，还要学习如何战胜它们。炼制药水，打造装备，鼓足勇气直面这片大陆最强大的霸主势力。
所有人都觉得巨龙不可战胜。但我们永远钟爱敢于逆流而上的勇者！
魔法求生，超凡蜕变
召唤幽冥巨斧，瞬息之间伐倒整片林木！化作魔法流光，瞬间传送逃离险境。将骸骨幻化成……成蜜桃？
烬落之地灵元充盈，蕴藏着世间独一无二的超凡力量。从湖泊之中召唤鱼群旋风！弹指一挥，便可引爆整条矿脉！游历烬落之地的缤纷地域，探寻破碎大地溢出狂乱魔法的缘由，驾驭这份力量立足求生！
社区驱动，玩家为本
跟所有《符文世界》系列作品一样，社区始终是我们一切创作的核心。我们依据玩家反馈制定整体开发规划，提前上线专用服务器，新增战斗玩法和剧情任务内容。我们将与玩家携手，持续打磨开发《RuneScape: Dragonwilds 符文世界：龙之荒野》。无论结伴游玩还是独自冒险，每一份意见都弥足珍贵，由你来帮助我们塑造游戏的未来。

critic.quote: If you enjoy the building and crafting aspects of a survival game you will enjoy this game, if you enjoy the exploration and combat of an RPG game you will enjoy this in fact there really isn’t much to dislike. This is a game where there is always something to do, a simple trip back to your base to drop off items and you can easily find yourself spending hours tending to your garden,cooking new re
RuneScape: Dragonwilds is a familiar yet bold twist on a classic, melding together different genres into a fun and addictive experience that seemingly has only just begun.

Overall, RuneScape: Dragonwilds has been a fun experience. A very beautiful atmospheric game where the way you experience it is really your choice. Jagex gives options to make it as hard or as easy as you want. You want difficulty? You got it. Want a standard play but with some exp adjustments and nothing else? You can do that. Want to negate needing runes for spells completely? You can! Super enj

I had an amazing time with RuneScape: Dragonwilds, and I find it to be one of the top survival games released in the past few years. It has a wonderful building system, and spells are not a forgotten item, they are at the core of the game in many ways. The progression system is simple, yet addictive, and the co-op gameplay is one of the best in its genre. RuneScape: Dragonwilds certainly has some

RuneScape: Dragonwilds successfully brings the familiar world and progression of RuneScape into the survival genre. Its skill system, building mechanics and clever use of magic make exploring Ashenfall genuinely rewarding, although combat can still feel stiff and the PC version could use further optimization. A solid and surprisingly addictive survival RPG, especially when played with friends.

There are undoubtedly other examples in the genre, but both its world and gameplay constantly remind you of RuneScape, giving Dragonwilds a distinct identity of its own. With a little more polish, it'll be an absolute treat.

The Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection is every bit as good as the individual games were upon their original release. This remastered collection shows exactly why the Uncharted series was and is so highly regarded, even 6 and 5 years later, respectively.

Both games this remaster aims to upgrade haven’t really aged at all, at least gameplay-wise. They are still epic, still a bit silly, still beautiful and still charming thanks to their characters. WWE 2K26 presents itself to fans of great pro wrestling as a revised and improved version of the previous game that smooths out some rough edges (while, unfortunately, leaving others unchanged) and further increases the enormous amount of content that has all the makings of keeping fans engaged for several hundred hours. The moment-to-moment gameplay was already excellent, but the improved collision and physics manage to push the presentation even further. WWE 2K26 plays it safe and it shows. This year's entry feels, in many ways, like a close relative of its predecessor. KT Racing is presenting its most ambitious project to date, but any and all good ideas fall by the wayside when it comes to technical quality and some decisions in the design of the progression.

Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown doesn’t break the mold of any other generic racing simulator, which isn’t inherently a bad thing. It definitely scratches the itch of purchasing cool cars, racing them, upgrading them, and customizing them. The backdrop of Hong Kong Island is beautiful, but the overall visual fidelity here is lackluster and disappointing, especially in 2024. The progression wipe an

The new Test Drive game is, unfortunately, marred by several issues, giving the impression of a title in (very) early access. Additionally, the car list is quite limited compared to the competition, and the handling model is derivative.

critic.quote: My time with Lies of P was exactly the intense and gratifying experience that I hoped for. As one who holds Bloodborne in the highest regard as one of FromSoftware’s finest achievements, I found myself absolutely enamored with Round 8 Studio’s unique, clever take on the formula. While the game broadly functions similarly to the best the Soulslike genre has to offer, Lies of P‘s tweaks and refineme
Neowiz took something well-known and really made it their own with stunning results. Lies of P is a game you can easily get lost in - provided you don't lose your cool.

All things considered, Lies of P is a product that has managed to convince us from practically every point of view. Neowiz's new work, although it plays very defensively and doesn't do anything truly new for the category to which it belongs, is a title with a living and breathing soul that reveals all the passion lavished by the studio during development. An exciting plot combined with the perfect
Warm recommendation for the fans of the Soulslike genre.

Lies of P is wearing Bloodborne’s cloak, but it has its own heart, one encased in metal and powered by ingenuity. It sometimes transfixes on tropes of the genre to its detriment, yet still overcomes by the sheer quality of its boss fights, combat mechanics, and world design. Lies of P’s steel heart may not be born of blood and flesh, but it still pumps heartily enough to be a worthy substitute for

Lies of P is a solid, well-thought-out game that – apart from some minor
touches of originality – sticks closely to the formula developed by
FromSoftware. Although every aspect of this Soulslike could be better, I
believe fans of the genre will have a lot of fun playing it (if you can
call dying 30 times in a row a lot of fun, that is).

critic.quote: If the goal of Persona 3 Reload is to modernize a classic JRPG from the PlayStation 2 era for a new generation of players, then it is undeniably a success. While there may be some legitimate disappointment over the lack of content from Persona 3 FES and Portable, what is here is more than enough to cement Reload’s status as a solid remake that delivers the now definitive version of Persona 3.

Persona 3 Reload is by far the best game in the franchise. With plenty
of new content, significant visual and performance improvements,
fine-tuned adjustments in all gameplay systems, and a captivating story,
it feels fresh on today's consoles. Addictive and stylish, Atlus's JRPG
is more than just a well-crafted remake, it's one of the greatest games
of the decade.

Revisiting a classic is an exciting proposition, yet there are always concerns about respecting the original. Persona 3 Reload doesn’t quite address all the shortcomings of its previous renditions, nor does it include all the extras added over the years. However, it’s another incredible take that stands proudly alongside the other stellar versions of the game. With all of its new additions and fea
The JRPG legend is back with a remake that build up the best way to play it.

A great remake that updates the Atlus classic to modern times with a new and stylish audiovisual section and with a multitude of interesting novelties and improvements. It is not the definitive version of this wonderful RPG, but it is the best and most enjoyable one, with an unforgettable story and characters, although the “dungeon crawling” in the Tartarus tower may not connect equally well with

As with all Persona games, Persona 3 Reload takes its time, both with its 80 hour story and its slow progression throughout the ingame months. If that's your thing, then there's an amazing game here with an interesting story, fun characters and outstanding music. The combat doesn't always hold up, but it mostly does and it's fun when it works.

critic.quote: If you are the type of person who liked the tactical aspects of Rainbow Six: Siege but was put off by the PvP elements then Extraction is just the tactical experience you will really enjoy.

While some of Rainbow Six Extraction‘s systems do feel a little unfair at times, there’s one hell of a thrilling experience to be found if you can get into the groove. I’m not usually a fan of stealth, but sneaking around the game’s excellently-designed environments trying to get the upper hand on a bunch of freaky-as-hell aliens is exhilarating. You’re constantly on-edge, not knowing what waits a

Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Extraction thinks outside of the box to provide a well-realised PvE experience that builds upon Siege’s already solid core tenets. While its longevity has yet to be proven or seen, Extraction’s addictive blend of cooperative, rogue-like, and stealth mechanics offers an engaging Rainbow Six experience, even if it’s a bit out there.

Net of an underlying repetitiveness that begins to emerge after a few hours of play, a non-exceptional enemy design and a series of fluctuations related to the balance of weapons and operators, Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Extraction is an intense and compelling cooperative shooter , able to offer an experience different from other exponents of the genre, more oriented towards frenetic action and litt

This drastic change in tone and structure from the Rainbow Six: Siege we've all come to enjoy is cool…for a time. The different alien types--while seeming overly familiar compared to other video game monsters--are fun to fight and strategize against. The objectives are fun and tense, and the "do we continue or leave now" choice is always filled with tension. I just wish there was more of this game

Those same elements that made the first one so enjoyable, combine with a better story, better customization systems, better level design and more, make Nioh 2 a confident sequel that stands above the previous game and firmly establishes itself as its own kind of game. No longer should Nioh be compared to other games; those other games should be compared to Nioh 2.

critic.quote: Astroneer is a survival space simulator that offers a rich and colourful experience based on some interesting game mechanics.

Astroneer is definitely on the soft side of the survival spectrum. It looks inviting and fun, whether your lone explorer is bounding across the colorful landscape or mining deep within underground caves. Collecting resources and crafting them into new tools is the main focus, and Astroneer falters in not having more interesting things to find within each planet. In the end though, it's a lovely li

It provides an experience that is generally therapeutic and almost never stressful. It’s not a perfect game, but it’s the kind of game that could be perfect for certain situations or groups of gamers looking for their next adventure.
Astroneer is a great adventure if you play it with someone, since playing it alone makes it quite simple and repetitive.

Astroneer provides a (mostly) tranquil environment to explore with your friends, or by yourself to unwind. The fact that the game doesn’t bury you in a collection loop and actually gives you breathing room to explore and tinker will be a downside for some, but for those with the patience, it’s a game you could easily spend hundreds of hours unraveling.
Chirpy and charming, Astroneer is a lovely survival game for players who want a chill experience. Just don’t expect much in terms of varied gameplay (for now).

In fact, the presentation during certain boss fights might even surpass the original, precisely because so much attention has been paid to i

All of this results in an experience that will appeal to those who know Elden Ring by heart and are masters of its combat system. However, if you don't fall into that group, Elden Ring Nightreign likely isn't for you. At the end of the day, FromSoftware presents us with a unique experiment that makes it clear that its 2022 title has the potential to expand almost anywhere, though that doesn't mean
It's fun, unexpected, and challenging. Everything you'd want from a title like this. Even if it doesn't look and feel exactly like we initially imagined.
Elden Ring Nightreign won't be every FromSoft fan's cup of tea, and this is especially true if you're a lone wolf.

Elden Ring Nightreign represents a bold attempt to evolve the Elden Ring universe through a cooperative and dynamic format. The streamlined progression and reduced exploratory freedom may not satisfy series purists, while the introduction of roguelike and battle royale elements does not fit perfectly with FromSoftware's design philosophy. Ultimately, Nightreign may attract a new audience, but for

critic.quote: Moving Out 2 is an enjoyable game with friends or family, but it can sometimes get a little frustrating. Playing alone can get boring.

Moving Out 2 succeeds in all the ways a sequel should. Keeping the best elements from the first game and interspersing them among a truckful of imaginative levels, Moving Out 2 is bigger, better and whackier than before. The different dimensions offer their own challenges and are aesthetically pleasing even in moments of frustration. The DualSense's subtle use is effective and makes pulling out el

Moving Out 2 improves on its predecessor in every single way. The addition of online multiplayer, more level variety and a host of accessibility options make Moving Out 2 one of the best same screen coop multiplayer experiences.

Bold, colourful and entirely silly, Moving Out 2 is a must-play for couch co-op fans. A sequel to 2020’s Moving Out perhaps wasn’t needed, and this doesn’t exactly reinvent the wheel. But it does provide fans with bigger, better, and more riotous levels to play with their friends. And this time, you can play online too! What more could we ask for, really?

Moving Out 2 is an accomplished sequel, building on what made the first game great and really honing in on its presentation and content offering. It's not a radical departure, and not all of its levels are designed equally, but overall this is another feather in SMG Studio's cap.

A sequel that improves the gameplay mechanics of the first Moving Out by heading in new directions, and that expands the amount and complexity of the challenges. In some cases, some immediacy is lost, but the fun is guaranteed, thanks also to the possibility of four-player play in both local and online modes.

critic.quote: Outlaws feels like a proper Star Wars game, but isn’t tied down to the Skywalker saga. The world feels suitably massive, with plenty of places to explore, skills to learn and dodgy dealings to get involved in. Developers have cherry-picked the best moments from groundbreaking titles such as Uncharted, Tomb Raider and The Witcher to create a unique, cohesive Star Wars title.

Overall, Star Wars: Outlaws delivers pretty much exactly what it promised. Players have the chance to take on the role of a smuggler to blast, sneak and fast-talk their way through the Star Wars universe. It does an excellent job of capturing the tone and feel of the franchise, and it feels like a Star Wars game should. It has its flaws and imperfections, but if you're looking for the chance to zo

Star Wars Outlaws captures the essence of the Star Wars universe with stunning visuals and engaging gameplay. It’s a thrilling adventure that stays true to the epic scale and feel of the galaxy far, far away. Fans of the franchise will find plenty to love in this must-play title, which delivers on both action and story.

Star Wars Outlaws is a production that pays homage to the source material in the best possible way. Despite a few imperfections, the gameplay mix between action and stealth works, and the credit for this is also to be found in the beauty of the settings that form the backdrop to the high-risk missions faced by Kay and Nix. The reputation system is interesting and well-crafted, and gives the idea o

Star Wars Outlaws turned out to be less of a typical Ubisoft game than I feared, offers a lot of great atmosphere and lets you roam around the galaxy quite freely, experience numerous gangster adventures and feel at least a little bit like a real smuggler. It can only gain in the coming weeks if the developers roll up their sleeves and fix some issues that include god-awful enemy AI and a couple o

Outlaws is an experience that, based on stealth and the most western adventure of Star Wars, offers a version of this franchise that we have not yet tasted in video games. It's not perfect and has several issues that are already common in this type of Ubisoft game, but it has heart and knows what to offer fans of the saga.

critic.quote: The new Trackmania builds itself on the best chapter of the franchise, laying the foundations for the future of the series.
After almost twenty years, the Trackmania formula remains brilliant. The game is fresh, fun and incredibly addictive, only partially thwarted by the seasonal release of the content.

Trackmania excels at everything fans fell in love with years ago: a true race with dozens of bizarre tracks and high speeds. The game unfortunately comes with a disclaimer: the different subscriptions, menus and leaderboards are very confusing. That is especially bad for new players, while Trackmania is such a good idea on paper.
The underlying principle is indestructible, but compared to its predecessors, the F2P restart disappoints with a lack of content and improvements.

The new Trackmania tries to merge E-Sport with the fun factor that all parts of the franchise contain. However, that doesn’t work out pretty well. On the other hand, it still has the strength of the predecessors: Easy to learn, but enough depth for pros. In addition, thanks to the free2play model every interested driver can give it a free shot.

Trackmania is a nice entry into the racing genre that provides a free version, along with paid versions that offer more content. The simple, fast-paced gameplay and official tracks are good, but it's best in short bursts. Official content doesn't take long to complete, so player creations are going to be important in keeping this game alive.

critic.quote: FragPunk stands out in the genre for its creative, reality-altering twist on familiar mechanics. Though I wish it leaned further into its unique aesthetic, it still distinguishes itself from the crowd and is absolutely worth trying.
Fragpunk's bold decision to break almost every rule in the book leads to a captivating shooter.
In a sea of tactical shooters, Fragpunk is the one finally willing to challenge the status quo.

Fragpunk stands out in the competitive free-to-play market with its vibrant visuals, unique Lancers, and game-changing Shard Cards that keep matches fresh. While the heavy reliance on microtransactions is a downside, the game’s innovation makes it an exciting contender. If future updates refine its progression, Fragpunk could carve out a lasting place in the genre.

Considering that there are 169 different Shard Cards, it feels like there is a lack of tactical and strategic depth in Fragpunk's team game setup, which Bad Guitar would need to work on. I've encountered some glitches with the netcode as well that would need to be tweaked but overall I've enjoyed this colourful action title.

As the clear standout elements in a shooter that otherwise feels like it's been drafted out of pre-existing parts, we'd like more change to actually play with our cards after tearing the packet open. [Issue#410, p.118]

critic.quote: Anyone who chews a bit of fantasy can never have imagined what it can be to fly on the saddle of a dragon shooting fireballs and spinning free in the air. Finally the dream becomes (partially) reality.

As much as I enjoyed my time in Century : Age of Ashes, I do have wonder how much staying power it will have. Since all classes are viable in each mode, I suspect many players may stick with one character class, get invested, and not explore the rest of what the game has to offer. As an example, I found myself only switching to other classes if the daily mission or hatching a dragon egg specifical
Century: Age of Ashes combines a great mix of ideas for an approachable, fun free-to-play game.

I really did like Century: Age of Ashes. It’s been a long time since I just sat and sank a few hours into an aerial combat game, and this one did not disappoint. Hopefully, some changes will come soon and I’ll be able to continue to enjoy flying my dragon and taking out my enemies.

Century: Age of Ashes has crisp visuals and smooth controls combined with an interesting spin on classic modes. Although, it has the potential to provide more enjoyment once it has more balance and more content.
Century: Age of Ashes is a solid, beautiful dragon-focused fantasy dogfighter that's within striking distance of greatness, once it hoards more content and balances its classes.

critic.quote: A great tribute for Final Fantasy fans and for the lovers of old school games.

A King's Tale: Final Fantasy XV isn't anything special, nor is it essential to understanding the main game you're buying into, so don't bust the doors down tonight trying to get a pre-order in. But at the same time, proponents of old school beat-'em-ups will enjoy a few hours of fun, which counts for something.
Quotation forthcoming.

For a free side course of Final Fantasy XV goodness, you can't go wrong with A King's Tale. It's nothing special – either as a new entry to the narrative or as a 2D brawler – but it provides some depth to a character that lacked development which, in turn, further expands upon the personality of Noctis and his relationship with Regis. Despite some lazy moments of design and unnecessarily repetitiv

critic.quote: With all around fantastic gameplay, graphics, design, and just overall fun, I’d argue that under different circumstances, this could have even been considered a game of the year contender. I never realized just how much the Sony PlayStation had influenced my life until I played this game.

This is a huge surprise. A “free game” that’s actually better than many of those you have to pay for - and also the best showcase of the capabilities of the DualSense controller which has the potential to change how we experience video games.
Astro’s Playroom is a creative surprise. For the PS5 launch Asobi Team serves up a jump-and-run highlight – preinstalled!

As well as being an excellent demonstration of the future ahead for owners of the PS5, Astro’s Playroom serves as an excellent, albeit brief platformer. You’ll find that just as the game really begins to come into its own, it ends, and that’s an almighty shame, but will likely you leaving salivating at the prospect of what is to come for Astro Bot and friends.
Astro's Playroom is just that; a playroom for the next generation - a small glimpse into what the PlayStation 5 will be able to do with the DualSense.

Astro's Playroom, a game that makes no attempt to hide the fact that it is an excuse to show you what a gamepad can do, conjures a world that you will want to see and explore. More than that, its surprisingly delightful celebration of PlayStation and its video games is a great way to kick off a console generation.

The new battle royale isn't without its missteps or annoyances, but it's a solid start that feeds your appetite for destruction.

I’m not sure why there’s reviews saying it’s “unplayable”… every game has some bugs but overall it’s been a very smooth experience for me game play wise.

s.desc:
Tite Kubo 的热门漫画和电视动画系列 Bleach 在这款 3D 砍杀动作游戏中栩栩如生！该游戏忠实地再现了 Bleach 动漫、Shonen Jump 漫画和小说的故事，并以精美的图形和全动作游戏玩法，充满爱意的细节。
潜入动感十足的漂白剂世界
从人类繁衍的生者世界，到死神和亡灵的家园——尸魂界，到被称为虚空的恶灵居住的荒凉的世界末日，再到地狱的深处，最后的安息之地。罪人，无限想象的漂白宇宙以高质量的 3D 图形重新创建。重温热门动漫中所有您最喜欢的场景和特殊技巧！
丰富多彩的角色
你最喜欢的 13 个宫廷卫队小队、Espada、Xcution、Stern Ritter 和千年血战的角色都在这里！释放 Ichigo 的 Getsugatensho、Aizen 的 Kyoka Suigetsu、Byakuya 的 Senbonzakura Kageyoshi 以及所有其他史诗般的 Bleach 动作，所有这些动作都配有令人惊叹的动画！

s.desc:
Cats with Guns 是一款融入轻度肉鸽元素的 2D 休闲游戏。你可以在战斗中做出策略决策，让一只小猫咪成长为强大而威风的战士。强化你的猫咪，运用强力技能击溃敌军。凭借猛烈火力迎战数量庞大的敌人，逐一击败敌方将领，最终抵达喵托邦。
故事发生在喵托邦城郊。猫咪们曾在这里幸福生活，直到老鼠大军入侵，迫使它们背井离乡。如今，一群坚定的猫咪组成了“九命旅团”，誓要从鼠群手中夺回家园。你将穿越一波又一波敌人，最终迎战老鼠入侵军的首领。

奈菲莉娅从长达3000年的沉睡中苏醒。为了通过试炼、晋升为神，她必须逃出金字塔。但考验远不止于此：她收集到的宝藏和遗物将决定最终的命运。如果宝物足以证明她的资格，她就能成为掌管财富与幸运的女神，从此享尽荣华，化身好运的象征；否则，等待她的只有永恒的不幸与苦难。她的命运由你决定。
举起雕刻精美的石块，用念力让它们在空中移动，为自己搭建跨越尖刺、深坑和箭矢陷阱的道路。每间密室都是精心设计的谜题，考验你的平台跳跃技巧与智慧。找到隐藏的出口，继续深入金字塔。别忘了搜寻宝藏，以免迎来糟糕的结局。

s.desc:
《Deadly Stakes》是一款暗黑风格的第一人称Roguelite游戏，其中赌博机制已成为一场致命医学实验的一部分。
你是一名被关在精神病院里的病人。为了获得出院许可，你必须经历一项又一项的“治疗”：操作诡异的赌博机、偿还不断累积的债务，并设法生存下来。
规则很简单：玩游戏、赢钱，并按时偿还债务。
听起来很简单。
直到你注意到天花板上的尖刺。
每一轮游戏起初都显得公平。转动老虎机、掷骰子、收集药丸，并逐渐将这些游戏机转化为为你效力的系统。购买奇特的医疗增强剂，改变赔率，提高派彩，触发重复激活，并将各种效果串联成能够彻底打破游戏平衡的连锁反应。
在这里，运气仅仅是起点。
你玩得越久，你的build就越强大——但你的债务也会随之增长。
《Deadly Stakes》特色：
两种不同类型的赌博机——老虎机和骰子游戏——各自拥有独特的规则和升级系统。
Roguelite 式奔跑，风险随你的实力增长而增加。
丰富多样的组合与协同效应，打造真正“破局”的build。
可反复获取并强化实验性能力。
两种相互关联的资源：金钱用于生存，药丸用于变强。
多个房间由统一的经济体系和共同目标联结在一起。
老旧精神病院令人窒息的氛围、医疗官僚体系以及强制性治疗程序。
《Deadly Stakes》并非一款赌博游戏。
头奖不会让你致富。
它只会为你争取到一点点时间。

帝国将陨是一款设定在柴油朋克世界中的回合制战术游戏。升级你的军队，指挥你的部队，然后利用地形，通过强大的力量和锐利的战术消灭敌人。
黑色帝国与蓝色联盟之间正在进行一场伟大的战争。这两个超级大国长期以来为统治权而斗争。在这款回合制战术游戏中控制任意一方，发起攻击，击溃对手！
受到经典作品的启发，《帝国将陨》采用基于网格的地图，操作简单易学。通过战略性地移动单位利用地形优势。选择你的立场——你会加入好战的黑色帝国，还是支持蓝色联盟的圣战？
特色：
- 非随机战斗。
- 多种单位类型，从坚韧的步兵到强大的坦克。
- 挑战你的战术技能的强大头目战。
- 热座多人游戏，支持在一台设备上挑战好友。
- 三个故事战役，包含手工设计的关卡，确保你需要智谋与力量并用才能成功。
- 可升级单位，具备特殊技能和弱点。

三只饥饿的山羊和一个坏脾气的山怪。三只小猪和一只呼呼吹气的大灰狼。还有一个好奇的小女孩，跟着一只金色蝴蝶来到三只熊的小木屋。
Story Time 是一款温馨的游戏，收录多部经典童话。每个故事都由手绘纸板木偶在玩具剧场里像电影一样精彩上演，并为孩子朗读全文；演出结束后，还有学习游戏和自然拼读等着孩子。
首发三个故事
Three Goats Gruff（三只山羊嘎啦嘎啦）、Three Little Pigs（三只小猪），以及加入原创情节的 Goldilocks and the Three Bears（金发姑娘和三只熊）：一只金色蝴蝶把金发姑娘带到小木屋，第二天她回来道歉，还修好了熊宝宝的椅子。
一起讲故事
每个故事都有完整配音，每个角色都有自己的声音。朗读时文字会逐一亮起，点一下任何单词就能再听一遍。孩子轻点屏幕来帮忙讲故事：帮山羊过桥，帮大灰狼吹气，陪金发姑娘尝尝粥、试试椅子和床。每一页还藏着一位小伙伴等你发现。
温馨的游戏室
菜单是一间小小的游戏室：放满故事书的书架、装着学习游戏的玩具箱、做自然拼读作业的书桌，还有奖杯柜。
学习游戏
每个故事都有记忆配对、故事问答、故事排序、比大小和单词游戏，还有一个动手搭建游戏：拼个山怪（Build a Troll）、盖座房子（Build a House）和煮锅粥（Make the Porridge）。每个游戏都有简单、中等和困难三个难度。
英语自然拼读
按教学顺序学习英语自然拼读（合成拼读法）的全部46个音。点一下就能听到读音，练习拼读和组合故事里的单词，看着单词收藏册一点点填满。
贴纸和奖杯
每个故事都有自己的贴纸册（Sticker Book）可以收集，一路上还能赢得奖杯。
照顾每位读者
易读字体、更大的文字和按钮、高对比度文字、更柔和的动画，所有说明都会朗读出来。
更多故事即将到来
更多故事正在路上，包括圣诞故事 The Night Before Christmas 和 The Elves and the Shoemaker，将作为追加故事推出。
无广告。本体游戏不含游戏内购买；追加故事另行单独销售。
请注意：本游戏为英文版（英式英语旁白、屏幕文字和自然拼读课程）。

店铺管理
设计您的店铺，兼顾效率与美观。规划商品陈列位置，管理货架布局，确保顾客享受流畅的购物体验。
补货管理
通过游戏内电脑下单采购。拆箱整理货物，将其分类存放于仓库，并摆放在货架、冷藏柜及冷冻柜中。
收银服务
扫描商品、处理现金与信用卡支付，确保顾客对购物及结账体验满意而归。
动态市场
应对实时市场的复杂变动。趁价格低谷采购商品，制定最佳售价以平衡顾客满意度与利润空间。
发展壮大
积累利润后可考虑再投资。扩建店铺空间，升级内部设施，持续适应零售业不断变化的需求。
个性化定制
打造独一无二的店铺。定制地板、粉刷墙面、设置分类标识等。
全城配送
并非每位顾客都会亲临门店。接收线上订单，打包商品，亲自完成配送。
采购本地市场
厌倦支付运费或四处寻找折扣？前往本地市场发掘最优货源。
清洁维护
让店铺焕然一新。擦拭地板、清运垃圾、擦亮窗户，保持环境一尘不染。
安全防护
并非每位访客都是顾客。安装监控摄像头与警报传感器，或雇佣保安人员防范偷窃行为。
多人协作
《超市模拟器》支持最多四位好友组队经营店铺。实时协作补货上架、接待顾客、处理网购订单、管理配送并拓展市场。从驾驶货车到清洁维护、定价策略，团队协作是打造成功超市的关键。
在《超市模拟器》中，每个决策都至关重要。你能否把握机遇，在平衡顾客满意度与财务状况的同时，将普通店铺打造成零售业巨头？

critic.quote: Supermarket Simulator is a Game Pass title that is oddly addictive. If you like sim games and playing with friends, this will tick many boxes. Although it is dated, I liked the core elements and the simple mechanics.

Supermarket Simulator is incredibly addictive, which is the hallmark of any good simulation game. It has that powerful “let me do just one more shopping day” appeal to it that could, and probably will, consume a hell of a lot of your time. Yes, it is a bit rough around the edges, but the core playability and the undeniable drive to make your supermarket the best in the neighbourhood are something

Grocery retail may seem like an odd subject for a sim game, but Supermarket Simulator absolutely pulls it off. It's seriously satisfying to see your store go from strength to strength, though it's a tad frustrating you can't delegate ordering.
